title: MB main-board voting record, both recorded wallets, A1–A289
scope: Complete main Phoenix board proposal module A inventory through A289, freshly enumerated 23 October 2026; no other DAO bodies, native Terra votes, company votes or off-chain decisions included.
attribution: The archived Phoenix Directive Terra Recovery Proposal names MB aejir beside the earlier wallet. A125 executed its replacement by the current wallet on27March2025 at23:41:42UTC. This supports professional account continuity, not exclusive custody.

membership_transition.limit: Actual successful execution is verified separately from proposal creation. Public named earlier-account association plus executed seat substitution supports attribution; exclusive physical key custody is not established.

single_no_vote_context.text: Philipp had already proposed corrected A29, whose description says A28 used the wrong contract and asks that A28 be vetoed. MB voted NO on A28 at 01:50:21 UTC and YES on corrected A29 at 01:55:31 UTC on 24 October 2024, 5 minutes 10 seconds later. This is a literal NO vote in a documented technical-correction context, not strong evidence of substantive policy disagreement. No individual rationale was recorded.

qa.timestamp_note: Current state reads span a short retrieval window; exact heights and dates are retained per capture. A285 remains open and may acquire later votes.

method: Reopened and hash-checked 283 historical primary ballot bodies. Retrieved all289 current proposal records and six new primary ballot bodies. Every saved named ballot sum matches the refreshed proposal tally, and each proposal disallows revoting. Matched every recorded MB ballot to exactly one successful vote transaction, including old archived and freshly retrieved delta.
limits: No recorded ballot is not NO, abstention, consent or a proved recusal.
Per-wallet counts across all289 include periods before or after that wallet appeared; use observed-period counts for missing-ballot comparisons.
A285 was open at capture; this is a dated snapshot.
Agreement or disagreement is a recorded vote fact, not proof of motive, coordination or independent reasoning.
The prior119/119 shared-YES result ended atA283. A284 is a newer current-wallet disagreement: MB YES, Philipp ABSTAIN.
